info.name: YouTube Neo Gradient Progressbar (2025 Style)
info.description: Bring YouTube into 2025 — gradient progress, improved buffering visuals, and a stylish round scrubber that scales on hover
info.additionalInfo:
Smooth red → magenta gradient for the played portion

Subtle white buffering indicator

Clean, round scrubber dot that’s always visible

Hover/drag scaling effect for better feedback
